source_name: IT Asociácia Slovenska (ITAS) – member directory and cluster listings
why_relevant: National IT association whose member list includes regional clusters (Košice IT Valley) and delivery-centre operators serving banks; a compact actor map for the IT-services side of financial nearshoring.

source_name: Greenpages.sk – directory of shared service centres (SSC) in Slovakia
why_relevant: Commercial directory listing business service centres operating in Slovakia; useful as a cross-check list of captive operators and their locations, including finance/banking back-office units.

source_name: Spaceplan – office market and shared-services centre commentary (SK)
why_relevant: Office-market intelligence linking SSC growth to leased square metres by city — an indirect but early physical-footprint signal of centre expansion or contraction in regional cities.

source_name: Deutsche Telekom Services Europe – Slovakia (LinkedIn company page)
why_relevant: Finance/accounting shared-services arm operating in Košice; company page carries hiring pushes, job-fair posts and leadership announcements for the regional centre.

source_name: Košický samosprávny kraj (KSK) – regional government news and investment/labour agenda
why_relevant: Self-governing region (a Košice IT Valley member) publishes memoranda with investors, regional development and skills-partnership announcements that accompany service-centre arrivals.

SLSP publishes board appointments and divisional responsibility changes here first, in Slovak. Verified examples found: appointment of Michaela Bauer as CEO (2026-03-02) and Slavomír Seemann as board member for finance (2026-05-25). Date-pathed URLs (/sk/aktuality/YYYY/M/D/slug) make crawling and dating trivial.

Living structured list of predstavenstvo members and their portfolios (retail, corporate & financial markets, IT & operations, risk, finance). Diffing snapshots reveals org-structure changes never issued as a press release.

Self-published hiring channel; volume and composition of openings (HQ digital/innovation roles vs branch roles, student/internship programmes) is a leading indicator of unit build-up or network shrinkage.

source_name: VÚB banka – Tlačové centrum / VÚB novinky
why_relevant: VÚB's own press centre carries management-reinforcement releases ('Posila vo vedení VÚB banky', 'Nové posily v manažmente VÚB'), which name incoming úsek directors and their portfolios — the primary route into this private Intesa Sanpaolo subsidiary's org structure.

source_name: VÚB banka – Informačný servis / Aktuality (document & notice feed)
why_relevant: Regulatory/document-update notices; useful as a secondary feed where organisational or governance documents are refreshed without a press release.
Openings split by branch network / specialised centres / HQ Bratislava, plus stated remote-work policy — a direct read on where the bank is adding headcount.
Tatra banka issues board-appointment releases on this path (e.g. 'Tatra banka má nového člena predstavenstva'), alongside product and foundation news; the leadership subset is the target.

'Management – Press – Analysts' hub listing the board and their portfolios (e.g. Oliver Pichler for finance, taxes, controlling, treasury and subsidiary management; Michal Liday as chairman/CEO). Slovak mirror exists under /sk/o-banke/.

source_name: Tatra banka – Výročné správy (annual reports archive)
why_relevant: PDF annual reports (2023, 2024, 2025 found) carry the authoritative year-end org chart, board/supervisory-board rosters and headcount — the backstop when press releases are silent about a departure.

Official press-release feed of the KBC-owned Slovak group; the natural first-publication point for board changes and for the ongoing 365.bank integration (KBC completed the 98.45% acquisition on 2026-01-15), which will drive substantial org and headcount change.

source_name: ČSOB Slovensko – O nás / Banka (group & leadership profile)
why_relevant: Corporate profile page carrying the group structure and leadership (Daniel Kollár as long-standing CEO/chairman); the reference state against which press-release changes are diffed.
The bank's own media channel; with KBC/ČSOB now the owner, this is where a Slovak-first announcement of divisional reorganisation or brand consolidation would appear.

Consolidated annual reports (2022, 2023 PDFs located) give board/supervisory rosters and headcount for the merged Poštová banka / 365.bank entity — critical baseline before the KBC integration reshapes it.

Still-live management page of the Poštová banka brand (now an odštepný závod of 365.bank). Two coexisting management pages across the two brands is itself a structural signal; diffing both tracks the consolidation.

The only self-published roster for this Penta-owned retail bank ('Jediná v každom okrese'); Prima banka issues few press releases, so this page plus the annual reports is effectively the whole self-published leadership channel.

Annual reports (2022–2024 PDFs located) contain the corporate-governance chapter: three-member supervisory board doubling as audit committee, board composition and branch-network figures. Fills the gap left by the bank's thin press output.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia – Tlačové centrum
why_relevant: Press centre for the CZ&SK entity whose Slovak arm is a branch (pobočka zahraničnej banky). Carried the appointment of Marco Iannaccone as chairman/CEO effective 2026-04-01. Note the Czech-flavoured URL path (tiskove-centrum) — a sk/cs mirror should be probed.

source_name: mBank SK – tlačové centrum (media.mbank.pl SK edition)
why_relevant: mBank's Slovak branch has no standalone SK newsroom on mbank.sk; it publishes through the group's dedicated SK press-room subdomain. Purpose-built press-room platforms usually expose clean release lists and often an RSS/press-kit feed.

Slovak-language press feed of the J&T branch. Leadership succession is currently live here: Slavomír Beňa replacing Štěpán Ašer as CEO from 2026-07-01, subject to ČNB approval — a textbook self-published leadership signal.

Slovak-language site of the Austrian Oberbank branch. Group-level board succession is in motion (Martin Seiter to become chairman of the board on 2027-01-01, described as a generational change), so the SK site and the Austrian group newsroom must be tracked as a pair.

source_name: FinStat.sk – company profiles for SK banks
why_relevant: Aggregates the register history (including historical names such as 'Poštová banka, a.s.' → 365.bank), financials and employee counts in one place — the fastest way to resolve an entity's ICO and register ID before hitting orsr.sk, and a cheap change-alert layer.

source_name: Banky.sk – per-bank profile and leadership-change section
why_relevant: A Slovak sector portal that maintains per-bank profile pages and a running 'zmeny v top manažmente' round-up. Excellent snowball surface: it points back to the originating bank press releases and covers the small banks (Oberbank, mBank, Privatbanka) that rarely surface in search.

Slovak banks (365.bank confirmed) syndicate their releases verbatim here. Acts as a uniform, easily-crawlable mirror that catches releases from banks whose own sites are bot-defended (e.g. Tatra banka) or lack a stable index.
